identificationModule.briefTitle: A Phase II Clinical Study to Evaluate HLX43 in Patients With Locally Advanced or Metastatic HCC Failed or Intolerance to Standard Therapy
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Clinical Study to Evaluate HLX43 (Anti-PD-L1 ADC) in Patients With Locally Advanced or Metastatic Hepatocellular Carcinoma (HCC) Failed or Intolerance to Standard Therapy

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The study is being conducted to to explore the reasonable dosage and evaluate the efficacy, safety and tolerability of HLX43 (Anti-PD-L1 ADC) in Patients with Locally Advanced or Metastatic Hepatocellular Carcinoma (HCC) Failed or Intolerance to Standard Therapy
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This study is an open-label phase II clinical study to explore the reasonable dosage and evaluate the efficacy, safety and tolerability of HLX43 (Anti-PD-L1 ADC) in Patients with Locally Advanced or Metastatic Hepatocellular Carcinoma (HCC) Failed or Intolerance to Standard Therapy. In this study, eligible subjects will be randomized at 1:1:1 ratio, and the patients will be administered with HLX43 at different doses via intravenous infusion.

armGroups.label: HLX43 DOSE 1
armGroups.description: Patients with good tolerability and well controlled disease will receive the treatment once every 3 weeks (Q3W), Until disease progression, initiation of a new anti-tumor therapy, death, emergence of intolerable toxicity, or withdrawal of informed consent (whichever occurs first)

armGroups.description: Patients with good tolerability and well controlled disease will receive the treatment once every 3 weeks (Q3W), Until disease progression, initiation of a new anti-tumor therapy, death, emergence of intolerable toxicity, or withdrawal of informed consent (whichever occurs first)

armGroups.description: Patients with good tolerability and well controlled disease will receive the treatment once every 3 weeks (Q3W), Until disease progression, initiation of a new anti-tumor therapy, death, emergence of intolerable toxicity, or withdrawal of informed consent (whichever occurs first)

interventions.name: HLX43 DOSE 1
interventions.description: Dose 1; HLX43 is an anti-PD-L1 monoclonal antibody conjugated with a novel high potency DNA topoisomerase I (topo I) inhibitor, with a drug-antibody-ratio (DAR) of 8.

interventions.name: HLX43 DOSE 2
interventions.description: Dose 2; HLX43 is an anti-PD-L1 monoclonal antibody conjugated with a novel high potency DNA topoisomerase I (topo I) inhibitor, with a drug-antibody-ratio (DAR) of 8.

interventions.name: HLX43 DOSE 3
interventions.description: Dose 3; HLX43 is an anti-PD-L1 monoclonal antibody conjugated with a novel high potency DNA topoisomerase I (topo I) inhibitor, with a drug-antibody-ratio (DAR) of 8.

primaryOutcomes.description: Objective response rate (ORR) (assessed by INV according to the RECIST v1.1 criteria)

Defined as the time (in months) from randomization to the first confirmed and documented progressive disease or death (whichever occurs first) as assessed by INV according to the RECIST v1.1 criteria.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of randomization until the date of first documented progression or date of death from any cause, whichever came first, assessed up to 14 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: Objective response rate (ORR) (assessed by the IRRC according to the RECIST v1.1 criteria)

Defined as the time (in months) from randomization to the first confirmed and documented progressive disease or death (whichever occurs first) as assessed by the IRRC according to the RECIST v1.1 criteria.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of randomization until the date of first documented progression or date of death from any cause, whichever came first, assessed up to 14 months
From randomization to death from any cause (up to approximately 36 months)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence and severity of adverse events (AEs)
secondaryOutcomes.description: severity determined according to National Cancer Institute Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events \[NCI CTCAE\] Version \[v\] 5.0, vital signs and clinical laboratory test results
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: time from the date of the first dose of study drug until the date of death from any cause, assessed up to 24 months
